lines.text: Paul hopes in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy soon, because he has nobody else like him who genuinely cares.
Timothy has served with Paul like a child with his father, and Paul will send him once he sees what happens with him.
Paul thought it necessary to send back Epaphroditus, his brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also the Philippians' messenger.
Epaphroditus is distressed because the Philippians heard he was ill, and he was sick nearly unto death, but Paul's mercy spared him.
Paul tells the Philippians to welcome Epaphroditus with great joy, because he nearly died for the freedom of Paul.
